articleTitle: Low threshold InAs/InP quantum dot lasers on Si
abstract: We have developed low threshold InP-based L-band quantum (QD) lasers monolithically grown on Si substrates for photonic integration. To overcome the fundamental challenges of growing high-density, high uniformity QDs on InP-based material system, QD thickness in combination with a modified indium flush technique was adopted, resulting in a low threshold current density of 1.35 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and pulsed lasing up to 100 °C. These results represent progress in C-/L-band QD laser development on Si, highlighting the potential for high-performance semiconductor light source for long-haul telecommunication applications.

articleTitle: Aluminum nitride-silicon hybrid thermo-optic phase shifter
abstract: We demonstrate a thermo-optic phase shifter based on an AlN-SOI platform, achieving a π-phase shifting power of 14 mW for Mach–Zehnder interferometers (MZIs) and 1.7 mW for ring resonators. Both the MZI and ring resonator phase shifters exhibit a bandwidth of 145 kHz.

articleTitle: Record 52.8 GHz 3-dB Bandwidth GeSn Photodiode Enabling 100 Gbps at 2 μm for Optical Interconnects
abstract: In this work, vertical mesa-structured GeSn Photodiodes (PDs) optimized for the 2 μm spectral window are demonstrated, address the critical demand for high-bandwidth receivers in next-generation optical interconnects. The device architecture, engineered through rigorous material and capacitance simulations, achieved a record-breaking 3-dB bandwidth of 52.8 GHz at -5 V bias—the highest reported for photodetectors operating in this wavelength regime—while maintaining an ultralow capacitance of 5.1 fF and a dark current of 32.1 μA. Notably, Demonstrating the first 100 Gbps NRZ transmission in the 2 μm band with a bit error rate (BER) of 4.72×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> at a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of 11.3 dB, and achieving 80 Gbps NRZ operation at a lower BER of 9.24×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−5</sup> with 14.5 dB SNR. The demonstrated performance, combined with wafer-scale manufacturing compatibility, establishes GeSn PDs as a key enabling technology for high-capacity optical communication systems leveraging the emerging 2 μm window.

articleTitle: Creating free-space beams with metamaterial engineered optical antennas
abstract: Emerging applications, including gas sensing or optical trapping, require beams collimated over centimeter-scale distances. We experimentally demonstrate the first silicon-on-insulator antenna that generates beams with a Rayleigh length of 6.2 cm. The device achieves a 54 % radiation efficiency with feature sizes compatible with deep-UV lithography.

articleTitle: Feedback strategy for 11-bit weight setting and phase control of Mach-Zehnder interferometers
abstract: A feedback strategy to control the output power and phase of Mach-Zehnder interferometers is presented. The strategy can set an arbitrary working point with >11 bit precision and stability for long-time operation. The use of in-line transparent sensors enables scalability for high-order meshes.

articleTitle: Photonic Latch Memory Based On Universal Optical Logic Gates
abstract: A silicon photonic set-reset latch using universal optical logic gates via electro-optic nonlinearity of ring modulators is reported. Optical set, reset, and outputs, and independent supply light enable scalability. Experimental and simulation results are demonstrated on a programmable platform for photonic gate and latch, respectively.

articleTitle: Multi-port Silicon Nitride Fabry-Pérot Cavity with Apodized Bragg Gratings for Dispersion Compensation
abstract: We demonstrate a multi-port Fabry-Pérot cavity with apodized Bragg gratings for dispersion compensation in silicon nitride. The gratings induce anomalous dispersion to counterbalance the waveguide’s normal dispersion, enabling precise control of the cavity’s dispersion for applications like optical frequency comb generation in silicon photonics.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wideband Polarization Insensitive Tunable Terahertz Modulator for 6G Communication
abstract: We propose a polarization-insensitive, tunable broadband modulator using a multi-stacked metamaterial integrated with VO₂. Our design enables a transition from a band-reject filter to nearly perfect reflection through external temperature control, offering potential for broadband communication and photonics applications.

articleTitle: Micro Transfer Printed Semiconductor Optical Amplifier at the 2 µm waveband onto SOI
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated InP-based semiconductor optical amplifier operating in the 2 µm waveband, realized by micro-transfer printing onto a silicon-on-insulator platform.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonic Traveling Wave Mach-Zehnder Modulators for 400G/Lane Transmitters
abstract: We demonstrate the potential of silicon photonic traveling wave Mach-Zehnder modulators for 400G/Lane transmitters. Operation at 345 Gb/s PAM6 and 414 Gb/s PAM8 were experimentally demonstrated. Simulations showed that 424 Gb/s PAM4 can also be achieved.

articleTitle: High-Efficiency and Low Back-Reflection Fully Etched TM Mode Silicon Waveguide Grating Coupler
abstract: We propose a novel design for high-performance fully etched TM waveguide grating coupler with minimum feature size above 260 nm. The device has low back reflection and high efficiency.

articleTitle: Passive AWG-assisted Optical Phased Array for High-Resolution 2D Beam Scanning
abstract: A high-resolution 65-channel arrayed-waveguide-grating-assisted passive optical phased array is reported based on an ultra-low loss silicon nitride platform. Two-dimensional (2D) beam steering over 25°× 5° field-of-view was demonstrated through 100 nm laser wavelength tuning with 0.06° vertical resolution and beam divergence of 0.55°× 0.07°.

articleTitle: Compact Mode-Division Multiplexer Using Inverse Design With Direct Binary Search Method and Thermo-Optic Effect
abstract: We propose a compact switchable mode-division-multiplexer based on inverse-design using thermo-optic phase-shifters and multimode-interferometer (MMI). The results demonstrate that arbitrary mode conversion from TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> to TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> to TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> can be achieved.

articleTitle: High-Efficiency Apodized Si-SiN Dual-Layer Waveguide Grating Antenna
abstract: We demonstrate an apodized half-millimeter-long Si-SiN dual-layer waveguide grating antenna with a Gaussian-profile diffraction efficiency of 76%, substantially exceeding its uniform counterpart. This improvement is achieved without compromising resolution, making the device well-suited for high-resolution optical phased arrays.

articleTitle: Universal All-Silicon Microring Modulator and Detector for O-Band operation
abstract: We demonstrate an all-silicon universal ring resonator operating in the O-band that functions as a high-speed modulator operating at > 64 Gb/s OOK and a photodetector exhibiting up to 48 Gb/s detection rate with a responsivity of 0.3A/W.

articleTitle: A Highly Integrated 1T CMOS Image Sensor with Enhanced Dynamic Range Performance
abstract: Tackling issues of low full well capacity (FWC) and dynamic range (DR) with the process of miniaturization, this paper presents a novel one-transistor (1T) complementary metal- oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) image sensor (CIS) pixel design based on semi-floating gate (SFG) transistor. A backside illumination (BSI), hole-collecting type, 3.1-μm-pitch pixel has been designed. It integrates a vertical photodiode, SFG MOSFET, and deep trench isolation. Key parameters show a remarkable FWC of 105000 h+ and a DR exceeding 94 dB.

articleTitle: Photonic Verification in IC Design? Yes, it can be done!
abstract: Keeping Moore's law afloat proved to be quite challenging. Hence, the semiconductor industry embraced alternative paradigms to enable further expansion. In this paper, we explain the verification challenges posed by curvilinear data pertaining to photonic structures and demonstrate the available innovative solutions in Calibre.

articleTitle: Full Short-wave Infrared High-speed Thin-film Lithium Niobate Electro-optic Modulator
abstract: We demonstrate a broadband integrated Mach–Zehnder modulator with a record 800-nm operation bandwidth in the shortwave infrared. The measured 3-dB electro-optic bandwidth of the modulator exceeds 67/67/48 GHz for the O-/C-/2-μm bands, facilitating high-speed data transmission beyond 100 Gbaud/λ across all these wavebands.

articleTitle: Automated intelligent design of ultrafast photodectors
abstract: This paper presents an automated intelligent design system for semiconductor photodetectors, which is capable of identifying the optimal performance of the photodetector under arbitrary material distribution. The aforementioned method was employed for the design of a modified uni-traveling carrier photodetector(MUTC-PD), exhibiting a bandwidth of 232GHz(@-5V) and an RF output power of 16.799dBm(@100GHz).

articleTitle: Two-step Transfer Printed Vernier Laser on Commercial Silicon Nitride Platform
abstract: We demonstrated the first heterogeneously integrated continuous-wave laser (CWL) on 300 nm thick silicon nitride commercial platform from VLC Photonics and INB-CNM, utilizing a two-step micro-transfer printing process. We achieved a tunable range of 34 nm, with Schawlow-Townes linewidth of 90 kHz.

articleTitle: Calibrated Full-Vector Beam Propagation Method (BPM) for Silicon Photonics
abstract: Full-Vector BPM can be calibrated by renormalizing the power to exclude any numerical loss/gain, which ensures power conservation. This approach has been automated and is readily applicable to high-index contrast waveguide structures like silicon photonics devices. It has been shown, in some cases, to be 1000x faster than FDTD with similar accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Ge/GeSiSn Quantum Cascade Laser and Detector
abstract: We present a feasibility study of lattice-matched Ge/GeSiSn quantum cascade structures that can be potentially developed into quantum cascade lasers and detectors in longwave infrared based on intersubband transitions. The optical transitions and carrier transport all occur within the L-valley of the conduction band.

articleTitle: Efficient Transmission Matrix Modeling and Optimization of Grating-based Biosensors
abstract: This work presents an efficient Transmission Matrix Model (TMM) for designing silicon nitride grating couplers in flow cytometry. The TMM simulates transient transmission with a four orders-of-magnitude speed increase over FDTD, enabling Bayesian Optimization that achieves a Peak-to-Baseline (P2B) transmission of 0.221.

articleTitle: 300mm IIIV on SOI laser integration process, fabrication and prototyping
abstract: The fabrication of SOI integrated IIIV lasers using a full 300mm CMOS foundry flow is reported. After SOI fabrication, IIIV Wafers are bonded then processed with CMOS compatible planar BEOL. The lasers are tested, exhibiting around 70mA threshold, 30dB SMSR with mW range output power.

articleTitle: Optically pumped lasing from InP membranes grown on silicon-on-insulator by tunnel epitaxy
abstract: We present a lateral tunnel epitaxy technique to grow InP membranes atop silicon waveguides on silicon-on-insulator substrates. Uniform InP membranes extending hundreds of micrometers in length can be achieved. Room temperature optically pumped lasing was also realized, showcasing the excellent crystal quality.

articleTitle: Observation of a spiking response in ITO/silicon waveguides
abstract: The potential of a hybrid indium tin oxide-silicon device for achieving an electro-optical spiking response with potential application in neuromorphic computing is proposed. We show that a certain combination of sub-microsecond electrical pulses may fire a momentaneous increase in the optical loss of our device.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Weighting System Based on Coupling-Variable Micro-Ring Resonator for High-Density Neural Network Applications
abstract: The performance of an electronic-photonic integrated weighting system with a coupling-variable micro-ring resonator, tunable readout circuit, and automatic calibration achieves higher weight range and resolution than traditional MRRs at increased channel density, enhancing scalability and precision for high-density neural networks in complex AI tasks.

articleTitle: Curved fishbone nanosticks to control the higher order 1-D photonic crystal cavity resonances
abstract: Uncontrolled higher order resonance competition in traditional 1-D photonic crystal high-Q cavities (nanosticks) can lead to mode-hopping when used in hybrid laser applications. Playing with evanescent phase matching coupling techniques to take out a single mode lack specificity due to the closeness of allowed resonances. Curving the structure is observed to be ideal for targeting higher order resonances.

articleTitle: Low loss PVD SiN waveguides with 300mm wafer size
abstract: We present a photonic platform based on Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) SiN at 300mm wafer size. C-Band (1550nm) propagation losses obtained for low deposition temperature of SiN (200°C) were down to 0.30dB/cm and 0.13dB/cm after annealing at 800°C. Low propagation losses were obtained as well for O-band (1310nm) and around 900nm wavelength. Those results, highlight the interest of PVD SiN for industrial scale photonic applications when a low temperature budget integration is needed with no compromise on performances.

articleTitle: Non-reciprocal magnetophotonic coupled waveguides
abstract: We propose a new approach to the design of integrated optical isolators, based on coupled waveguides hybridized with a magneto-optic material. We present the basic theory, leading to isolator configurations that exhibit remarkable performance, including 20dB isolation over a bandwidth of ~35nm at telecom wavelengths.

articleTitle: InGaAs/GaAs Nano-Ridge Laser Based on Bound States in the Continuum Epitaxially Grown on a Si Wafer
abstract: We demonstrate a novel vertically emitting nano-ridge laser epitaxially grown on a 300-mm silicon wafer. By leveraging the concept of bound states in the continuum (BICs), we achieve confined optical modes with high Q-factors within the structure. We experimentally show low threshold lasing (10 kW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>).

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of a 2-D Dense Optical Phased Array
abstract: We demonstrate a compact two-dimensional optical phased array that routes light on-chip using evanescent coupling between a bus waveguide and antenna elements. With this method, the integration of hundreds of antennas in a compact design space is possible. An 8×20 OPA is fabricated and achieves a steering range of 31.4°.

articleTitle: Miniaturized Photothermal Spectroscopy based On Silicon Nitride Photonic Integrated Circuits And Lensed Fiber Array
abstract: We developed an on-chip Photothermal Spectroscopy (PTS) method for gas detection using a Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>-based MRR transducer and SU8 waveguide for excitation. Gas molecules excited by a 1395 nm diode laser, matching the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O absorption line, were detected by the MRR with a lensed fiber array.

articleTitle: Photonic parallel convolutional processing based on spectrum slicing on silicon photonics platform
abstract: We have demonstrated a photonic CNN system employing spectrum slicing on a broadband light source and testing with MNIST handwritten characters dataset. The standard deviation of the photonic multiply-accumulate operations is 0.0417, resulting in the bit precision of 4-bit, with a recognition accuracy reaching 94.4%.

articleTitle: Sb2Se3-based reconfigurable 4x4 Benes switch matrix
abstract: A reconfigurable 4x4 Benes switch matrix is demonstrated using the low loss phase change material Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> as the phase shifter in the MZIs. The phase shifter is based on a 6 µm-long Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/Silicon waveguide activated by optical pumping.

articleTitle: Low-loss 200-mm diameter SiN platform including WI-SNSPD for quantum photonics applications from 900 to 940 nm
abstract: We demonstrate a SiN platform dedicated to quantum photonics around 900 to 940 nm. The platform is designed to operate with available deterministic single photon sources. Waveguides and passive photonic devices highlight low propagation and insertion losses. Highly performing waveguide-integrated SNSPD allow for efficient on-chip single photon detection.

articleTitle: Mode-evolution based polarization rotator with adiabatic vertical transition between SiN and Si layers
abstract: We propose a polarization rotator with vertical mode transition between silicon nitride and silicon layers for the C-band spectrum. The device is fabricated with standard processes of a commercial foundry, and exhibits an average polarization extinction ratio of 20dB over the C-band.

articleTitle: Leveraging Architectural Redundancy for High Contrast Nulling with Photonic Meshes
abstract: We present a triangular mesh of dual-Mach Zehnder Interferometers (DMZIs) for high-sensitivity sensing applications. This architecture significantly enhances the achievable extinction ratio of a photonic integrated circuit (PIC), exceeding 80 – dB. This is made possible by added circuit complexity which simultaneously compensating for fabrication errors and other non-idealities such as back reflections within the circuit.

articleTitle: A 25-Gbaud 4-Lane Fully-Integrated CMOS Optical Receiver IC Array
abstract: This paper describes a 25-Gbaud 4-lane fully-integrated CMOS optical receiver array with NRZ and PAM4 signaling. The receiver is fabricated in a 90-nm CMOS silicon-on-insulator (SOI) process, and it includes inverter-based single-ended transimpedance amplifier, limiting amplifier, and on-chip photodetector. The receiver array consumes only 10-mA per lane at a 1-V single supply and achieves 3-dB bandwidth of 16.5GHz by using cascaded amplifiers with transconductance and transimpedance combinations. The integrated receiver is measured and analyzed with electrical and optical probes, and it achieves -4.5dBm of optical sensitivity for 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup> BER at 25-Gbaud symbol rates for NRZ and PAM4 signals.

articleTitle: GeSn 320 × 256 Focal Plane Array for Silicon-Based Short-wave Infrared Imaging
abstract: In this work, a high-performance 320×256 focal plane array based on group-IV semiconductors has been manufactured on a Si substrate using Ge0.9Sn0.1 film as absorption material. With the help of the read-out circuits, SWIR images have been successfully captured for the first time.

articleTitle: Microring Modulator-Based O-Band Coherent Transmission: 400-Gbps Net Rate per Polarization
abstract: We report the first demonstration of a net rate of 400 Gbps/λ/polarization O-band transmission using a microring-based coherent transmitter in 16-QAM at 120 GB, achieving a record bandwidth density of 4 Tbps/mm. We also achieved QPSK up to 160 GB back-to-back and 100 GB QPSK over 7 km.

articleTitle: Concept of Hg2Cl2 quasi-collinear AOTF with Glan-Foucalt polarizer for LWIR operation
abstract: Acousto-optical tunable filters (AOTFs) offer superior spectral resolution in quasi-collinear configurations but are limited to wavelengths below 5 µm. Mercurous chloride (Hg<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Cl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) extends AOTF capabilities into the LWIR range. We present a Hg<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Cl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</inf>based quasi-collinear AOTF with a Glan-Foucault polarizer, its measurement procedure, and construction limitations.

articleTitle: Optical Phased Array Receiver Field of View Extension using Higher Order Spatial Modes
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that using higher order spatial modes can effectively improve the field of view and receiving efficiency of an optical phased array receiver.

articleTitle: A Highly-Scalable Integrated Silicon Photonics Neural Network Architecture
abstract: A highly scalable optical neural network architecture based on the PQ Compress method is proposed. By using reported photonic components on a heterogeneous silicon pho-tonic platform, a minimal 332× chip size reduction is achieved when it scales up to a 784 × 784 network (MNIST).

articleTitle: High Bandwidth All Silicon 3nm-MOSCAP Ring Modulators
abstract: We demonstrate a 3 nm t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ox</inf> MOSCAP ring achieving a BER <1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−12</sup> up to 50 Gbps and an open eye at 100 Gbps. A 3 dB ER is achieved with 1.5 dB IL<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">one</inf> or 1 V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</inf>.

articleTitle: Demonstration of High Responsivity, Low Dark Current Ge/Si Avalanche Photodiode using Silicon Photonics Foundry Process with Zero Change
abstract: We demonstrated Ge/Si avalanche photodiodes compatible with standard silicon photonics foundry process without any modifications, showing responsivity > 7.5 A/W at < -20 V operation and low dark currents of 1.4 nA for 3 A/W responsivity near breakdown suitable for optical networking applications.

articleTitle: Multi-band 200 GBd Transmission Using a PLZT Modulator
abstract: We demonstrate a ferroelectric crystal (PLZT) MZI modulator based on strong Pockels effect. The device performed 200 GBd modulation for both C- and O-band transmissions.

articleTitle: Net 300 Gb/s Unamplified Transmission using a Differential Drive SiP TW-MZM
abstract: We demonstrate record unamplified transmissions of 256 Gbaud OOK, 155 Gbaud PAM4 and 128 Gbaud PAM6 using a C-band differential-drive SiP TW-MZM, achieving BER performance below the 6.25 % HD-FEC threshold after 100 m SMF transmission.

articleTitle: Membrane InGaAlAs Electro-Absorption Modulator Integrated with III-V/Si DFB Laser with 150-Gbaud Modulation on Si Photonics Platform
abstract: We fabricate an O-band membrane InGaAlAs electro-absorption modulator (EAM) integrated with a III-V/Si DFB laser on a Si photonics platform. The device exhibits 6-mW fibre-coupled output power through the EAM and over 67-GHz EO bandwidth. Clear eye-opening with a 150-Gbaud NRZ signal is also achieved.

articleTitle: GeSn Infrared Photodiode (PD) for Optical Wireless Communication (OWC) at 2 μm Wavelength Band
abstract: We demonstrate a germanium-tin (GeSn) photodiode (PD) for optical-wireless-communication (OWC) applications. It can detect a 400 Mbit/s on-off-keying (OOK) modulated signal fulfilling the pre-forward-error-correction (FEC) threshold (i.e. bit-error-rate, BER = 3.8 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>).

articleTitle: Germanium microring avalanche photodetector for 2 μm wavelengths
abstract: Waveguide-coupled Ge avalanche photodetector operating at 2 μm wavelength was demonstrated on GeOI platform. Thanks to microring resonator and avalanche gain, we achieved 2.18 A/W responsivity at -11 V and clear eye diagram at 2.5 Gbit/s, proving the potential of GeOI for mid-infrared photonics applications.

articleTitle: Silicon-rich Silicon Nitride on Lithium Niobate thin film modulators with 100 GHz Electro-Optical bandwidth in the C-band
abstract: We report silicon-rich silicon nitride on lithium niobate Mach-Zehnder modulators, achieving an efficiency of 2.9 V.cm, insertion losses of 1.8 dB and an electro-optical cut-off frequency as large as 100 GHz at a wavelength of 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Acousto-optic modulation on aluminum scandium nitride - silicon hybrid integrated platform
abstract: We demonstrate an acousto-optic modulation device based on an AlScN – SiO2 − SOI platform, achieving a π-phase voltage of 33V and a voltage-length product of 0.66 V ⋅ cm.

articleTitle: Impact of Laser Detuning on Four-Wave Mixing in Microring Resonators
abstract: Dual-pumped four-wave mixing of microring resonators fabricated on a dispersive silicon on insulator material platform is experimentally explored. The conversion efficiency is obtained as a function of the pump laser detuning.

articleTitle: High-Speed Silicon-Conductive Oxide Microring Modulator Array with Thermal-Free Wavelength Control
abstract: We demonstrated a 1×4 titanium-doped indium oxide-gated MOSCAP silicon microring modulator array, utilizing DC gate bias tuning without thermal heaters for wavelength control. It achieved high-speed data rates of 25 Gb/s, maintaining equally spaced wavelengths with extremely low power consumption in the pW/nm range.

articleTitle: Single-mode laser strategies for edge-coupled micro-transfer printed devices on silicon
abstract: We compare 3 strategies for single-mode lasing using transfer-printed edge-coupled gain sources to SOI waveguides, namely slotted laser, extended cavity with ring resonator and extended cavity with Bragg grating. Detailed spectral measurements are used to analyse the devices, which achieve over 40 dB SMSR.

articleTitle: Silicon integrated low-dimensional material photodetectors
abstract: The low-dimensional materials (LDMs) provide promising solutions for low-integration-cost, high-performance, and broadband photodetection in the silicon photonic integrated circuits. This talk will introduce our recent works around this topic, including several types of ultra-fast silicon integrated graphene photodetectors and high-sensitivity silicon integrated LDM photodetectors.

articleTitle: Ultra-sensitive refractive index sensing using a Hybrid photonic crystal external cavity laser and the optical heterodyne technique
abstract: This study presents a breakthrough in refractive index sensing by combining a silicon nitride 1D photonic crystal cavity in a hybrid external cavity laser with the optical heterodyne technique. Achieving ~10⁻⁷ RIU detection limit, which represents 400x improvement in detection capability over existing high-sensitivity devices.

articleTitle: Theoretical Calibration of Phase Errors in Optical Phased Arrays
abstract: This paper presents, for the first time, a comprehensive theory-based calibration method for the phase error of the optical phased array (OPA) LiDAR, which is experimentally validated using a 16-channel OPA chip.

articleTitle: Plasmon-enhanced Au and Ag-heterostructures 2D materials from nonlinear and photodetector applications at broad wavelength
abstract: The 2D materials such as MoS2, WS2 and rGO heterostructures will be implemented for nonlinear and photodetector applications integrated with plasmonics nanoparticles. The findings depict the coupling effects of plasmonic where interactions between 2D materials and incident photons are significantly enhanced through surface plasmon resonance.

articleTitle: On-chip entangled photon-pair generator on the SOI platform
abstract: This work reports recent progress in developing silicon photonic circuits for on-chip generation and manipulation of entangled photon pairs. We successfully integrated three essential functions— photon-pair source, pump filtering, and demultiplexing—into a single silicon chip. Key performance results include a high-quality resonator (Q-factor > 100,000), pump rejection over 80 dB, and efficient signal-idler separation with minimal crosstalk (better than 40 dB). These advancements pave the way for high-brightness photon-pair generation and manipulation, beneficial for quantum applications.

articleTitle: Thermo-opto-mechanical properties of GeSn micro-disks: a comprehensive analysis
abstract: Combining finite element method calculations, Photoluminescence spectroscopy and X-ray diffraction microscopy, we provide a detailed analysis of the interplay between mechanical, optical and thermal properties of Germanium-tin microdisks with Sn concentration between 8.5 and 14 at.%., promising structures for CMOS-compatible lasing.

articleTitle: Design of Mid-Infrared Graphene Optical Modulators and Detectors with Gigahertz Bandwidth on Suspended Silicon Waveguides
abstract: We use experimental material parameters to design mid-infrared graphene optical modulators and detectors integrated on suspended silicon waveguides with 3 dB bandwidth in the gigahertz range. Our results demonstrate how graphene may bridge the speed gap between group IV and III-V mid-infrared integrated photonics.

articleTitle: Inverse Design of Bragg Grating Filters Using a Hybrid Optimization Algorithm
abstract: We propose a hybrid optimization algorithm to inversely design silicon Bragg grating filters. By optimizing the coupling coefficient profile, we achieve a narrow-band Bragg grating filter with a 3-dB bandwidth of 2 nm and a high sidelobe suppression ratio (SLSR) of 19 dB.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact electro-optical modulators based on monolithic BaTiO3 on silicon
abstract: Monolithic BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> electro-optic devices were fabricated from commercially available wafers of BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Si. The material demonstrated exceptional uniformity and structural quality. The fabricated devices supported high EO coefficient and low optical loss. Ring resonators with Q factors ~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> and propagation loss <0.15 dB/cm were demonstrated.

articleTitle: CW electrically pumped GeSn/SiGeSn MQW lasers
abstract: A continuous-wave (CW) electrically pumped Si-based laser operating at room temperature (RT) is known as the "holy grail" in the group-IV community. This work presents the first step in this direction presenting a CW electrically pumped GeSn/SiGeSn multi-quantum-well (MQW) laser. Cavity design improvements like micro-ring geometry result in a decrease in the threshold and a strong improvement in the laser performance. The laser operates in a CW and/or pulse regime below 100 K.

articleTitle: Long Short Term Memory Regression and Dense Neural Network Enabled 200-Gbit/s PAM4 using GeSi Electro-Absorption Modulator (EAM)
abstract: A long-short-term-memory-regression (LSTM) and dense-neural-network (DNN) enabled high-speed four-level pulse-amplitude-modulation (PAM4) generation using GeSi electro-absorption modulator (EAM) is demonstrated. It supports 200-Gbit/s 1-km standard-single-mode-fiber (SSMF) and 240-Gbit/s back-to-back (B2B) transmissions fulfilling the soft-decision-forward-error-correction (SD-FEC).

articleTitle: Grating coupler design for VCSELs heterogeneously integrated on silicon nitride
abstract: Scaling computing infrastructure requires optical I/O with higher bandwidth density and lower power consumption. We propose a bi-layer grating coupler on a low-loss silicon nitride platform for heterogeneously integrated VCSELs using micro-transfer printing. Simulations show a -1.2 dB coupling efficiency from VCSELs to the waveguide.

articleTitle: Photonic Integrated Circuits for Refractive Index-Based Detection in Liquid Chromatography
abstract: We demonstrate the on-chip integration of silicon nitride refractive index transducers with microfluidics for refractive index-based detection in liquid chromatography, highlighting the system's potential for creating compact, highly sensitive, and selective sensors capable of analyzing a wide range of complex liquid samples and analytes.

articleTitle: Optical Power Induced Bandwidth Enhancement in Silicon Microring Modulator (SiMRM)
abstract: We demonstrate an optical-power-induced modulation-bandwidth-enhancement in silicon-microring-modulator (SiMRM), illustrating 3-dB frequency-response increases from 55 to 70GHz. Orthogonal-frequency-division-multiplexing (OFDM) data is applied, illustrating data-rate increases from 62.31 to 70.17Gbit/s fulfilling the forward-error-correction (FEC) threshold.

articleTitle: Ultra-High-Coherence Quantum-Dot Laser for Silicon Photonic Integrated Circuits
abstract: This paper presents an ultra-high-coherence quantum-dot laser grown on a silicon substrate, achieving a record-breaking intrinsic linewidth of 16 Hz. This approach is compatible with low-Q external cavities for linewidth reduction and integration with silicon photonics.

articleTitle: Silicon thermo-optic switch based on photonic crystal nanobeam cavity with doped-silicon heaters
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon TO switch based on photonic crystal nanobeam cavity with doped-silicon heaters. The insertion loss and crosstalk are less than 2.01 dB and -9.78 dB, respectively. The thermo-optic tuning efficiency is calculated to be 0.47 nm/mW.

articleTitle: Extraction of Recombination Coefficients for Electrically Injected InGaAs/GaAs Monolithic Nano-ridge Laser Diodes Integrated on Silicon
abstract: We present the extraction of recombination coefficients for electrically injected monolithic nano-ridge laser diodes by first determining the effective carrier capture time from the small signal modulation response. The effect of the nano-ridge box size on the recombination coefficients is investigated.

articleTitle: Harnessing optomechanical interactions in unreleased silicon resonators
abstract: Integrated optomechanics finds increasingly broadening applications. Here, we propose and demonstrate a novel approach to simultaneously confine optical and mechanical modes in non-suspended silicon resonators using subwavelength structuration. A record acoustic quality factor of up to 1280 is achieved under ambient conditions and room temperature.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wide Adiabatic Microring Resonators Based on Euler Curve and Modified Bessel Curve for Improved Variation Tolerance
abstract: We optimized the inner contour of an ultra-wide adiabatic curved waveguide based on high-order Bessel curves using inverse design method to achieve the stable mode transmission. The adiabatic microring formed by the designed curved waveguide exhibits low transmission loss.

articleTitle: Adaptive Time-Multiplexed Control of a Silicon Photonic Coherent Adder
abstract: Adaptive time-multiplexed control of a reconfigurable silicon photonic coherent adder is demonstrated by using monolithically integrated CMOS electronics. Time-multiplexing is used to interrogate integrated photodectors and drive thermal actuators, realizing accurate compensation and locking of mutual phase drifts of the input signals to be combined.

articleTitle: Towards precise trimming and programming of photonic integrated circuits
abstract: Methods to achieve a high-resolution phase trimming within silicon waveguides incorporating Ge implanted sections are investigated. The trimming is performed electrically using on-chip microheaters. The average resolution of phase change per voltage pulse achieved by this work was approximately 0.0007π radians.

articleTitle: High-Efficiency InGaP-on-Silicon Frequency Downconversion for Quantum Communication Applications at 1550 nm
abstract: Efficient down-conversion in InGaP-on-silicon waveguides enables single-photon conversion from 930 nm to 1550 nm (C-band), advancing scalable, CMOS-compatible quantum communication and sensing from quantum dots. This integration showcases a promising approach for high-performance, monolithically integrated quantum frequency converters in photonic platforms.

articleTitle: Efficient all-optical wavelength conversion in low-loss silicon waveguides within the 2-μm waveband
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate mid-infrared wavelength conversion in silicon waveguides over a wavelength range of 314.9 nm, achieving a conversion efficiency of up to - 12.09 dB. All-optical wavelength conversion of 10-Gbit/s data signal is achieved within the 2-μm waveband, with a power penalty of 2.56 dB.

articleTitle: Non-volatile Si microring resonator switch with Ge2Sb2Te3S2 optical intensity modulator
abstract: We demonstrate microring resonator (MRR) optical switch using phase change material Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Te<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> (GSTS). With negligible optical absorption in amorphous GSTS, the MRR maintains its Q-factor after GSTS integration. Successful non-volatile switching is achieved over broad wavelength range with crystalline GSTS, enabling multi-wavelength programmable photonic circuits.

articleTitle: High Modulation Linearity of Double Injection Microring Fano Modulators
abstract: An optimal Fano double-injection microring modulator is tuned by controlling the phase difference between the two electric fields injected into the ring, along with fine-tuning the operating wavelength of the ring modulator. The measured spurious free dynamic range (SFDR) exceeds that of a commercial LiNbO3 modulator.

articleTitle: Electronic-Photonic Integrated Circuits through Micro-Transfer Printing
abstract: We realized low-ohmic, high-speed interconnects to transfer-printed, 20 μm thick electronic chiplets with small (20 μm×20μm) pads. Spray-coated divinylsiloxane-bis-benzocyclobuten (DVS-BCB) ramps were created, onto which a lithographically defined metal redistribution layer including vias was fabricated. This approach facilitates short (low parasitic) interconnects between electronics and photonics.

articleTitle: Aspect Ratio Trapping based Selective Ge growth under Ultra High Vacuum Chemical Vapor Deposition conditions
abstract: In this work, high-quality Ge film was selectively grown on a Si substrate using digermane under ultra-high vacuum chemical vapor deposition conditions. A low-defect-density film was achieved via aspect ratio trapping, with most dislocations confined within the silicon dioxide trenches.
